warranty.notes: 70% of system energy at 10 years or the Minimum Throughput Energy, whichever comes first. 16 MWh per 5.12 kWh module. Throughput is the battery's total output (discharged) energy recorded by its control module, from the warranty start date (the earlier of installation or six months after production).

notes: Low-voltage stacked module, 5.12 kWh, 1-6 per stack, up to 6 stacks in parallel. The AU brochure gives usable energy at 100% depth of discharge (other regions: 90%).
